items.pos: v. 招募 | n. 新進人員
items.colloc: recruit staff 招募員工 | actively recruit 積極招募
items.distinct: hire 僱用 | employ 聘僱
ex: The firm plans to recruit more engineers next month.
公司計畫下個月招募更多工程師。
They are actively recruiting for the marketing team.
他們正在積極為行銷團隊招募人員。
Recruiting top talent remains our highest priority.
招募頂尖人才仍是我們最高優先事項。

items.colloc: resume screening 履歷篩選 | initial screening 初步審查
items.distinct: selection 挑選 | assessment 評估
ex: The screening process takes at least two weeks.
篩選過程至少需要兩個星期。
Applicants must pass the initial screening phase.
申請人必須通過初步篩選階段。
Our HR team is currently screening new resumes.
我們人資團隊目前正在篩選新履歷。

items.pos: v. 取得資格 | 使具有資格
items.colloc: qualify for 具備...資格 | fully qualify 完全符合資格
items.distinct: eligible 合適的 | competent 有能力的
ex: Only those who qualify will be contacted by email.
只有符合資格的人才會收到電子郵件通知。
Does your background qualify you for this role?
你的背景讓你具備擔任此職位的資格嗎？
She qualified for the position after the exam.
她在考試後取得了該職位的資格。

items.colloc: headhunt talent 獵取人才 | actively headhunt 積極挖角
items.distinct: recruit 一般招募 | hire 僱用
ex: The agency was hired to headhunt a new director.
該機構受聘去獵取一位新總監。
They often headhunt managers from rival companies.
他們經常從競爭對手公司挖角經理。
It is common to headhunt experts in this industry.
在這個產業獵取專家是很常見的。

items.pos: v. 使熟悉環境 | 入職引導
items.colloc: onboard employees 引導員工 | onboarding process 新進引導流程
items.distinct: orient 適應 | train 培訓
ex: We need to onboard new hires by next Monday.
我們需要在下週一前完成新人的入職引導。
The onboarding process helps them adjust quickly.
入職引導流程能幫助他們快速適應。
She helped onboard the interns during the summer.
她在暑假期間協助引導實習生。

items.pos: v. 將...列入決選名單 | n. 決選名單
items.colloc: shortlist candidates 列入決選名單 | on the shortlist 在決選名單上
items.distinct: candidate 候選人 | finalist 決賽入圍者
ex: We will shortlist five candidates for the interview.
我們會將五位候選人列入面試決選名單。
His resume was moved to the final shortlist.
他的履歷被放進了最後決選名單。
It is difficult to shortlist the best applicants.
要將最好的申請人列入決選名單很困難。

items.colloc: apply for an internship 申請實習 | summer internship 暑期實習
items.distinct: training 訓練 | apprenticeship 學徒制
ex: She completed a three-month internship at the firm.
她在該公司完成了三個月的實習。
Many students apply for this internship every year.
每年都有許多學生申請這份實習。
This internship offers a chance for permanent employment.
這份實習提供了轉正職的機會。

items.colloc: core competency 核心能力 | demonstrate competency 展示能力
items.distinct: ability 才能 | skill 技能
ex: The job requires a high level of technical competency.
這份工作需要高水準的技術能力。
We evaluate every candidate based on key competencies.
我們根據關鍵職能來評估每位候選人。
Strong communication is a core competency for sales.
良好的溝通能力是業務的核心職能。

items.colloc: probation period 試用期 | on probation 在試用期內
items.distinct: trial 審判 | assessment 評估
ex: All new employees are subject to a three-month probation.
所有新進員工都有三個月的試用期。
He passed his probation and became a full-time member.
他通過試用期並成為正式成員。
Management will review her performance after the probation.
管理層將在試用期後評估她的表現。

items.pos: n. 總人數 | 人力編制
items.colloc: reduce headcount 裁員 | increase headcount 增加人力
items.distinct: personnel 人事 | staff 員工
ex: The department needs to increase its headcount this year.
該部門今年需要增加人力編制。
Management decided to reduce the total headcount.
管理層決定減少總員工人數。
We have reached our maximum headcount for the project.
我們已經達到了該專案的人力上限。

items.colloc: educational background 教育背景 | professional background 專業背景
items.distinct: history 歷史 | experience 經驗
ex: They are looking for someone with a design background.
他們在尋找具備設計背景的人。
Please provide details about your professional background.
請提供關於你專業背景的細節。
Her diverse background makes her a strong candidate.
她多元的背景使她成為強有力的候選人。

items.colloc: submit a resume 提交履歷 | update a resume 更新履歷
items.distinct: CV 學術履歷 | portfolio 作品集
ex: Please attach your resume to the email application.
請將你的履歷附加在電子郵件申請中。
The recruiter spent time reading through her resume.
招募人員花時間詳讀了她的履歷。
You should update your resume with recent achievements.
你應該用近期的成就來更新履歷。

items.pos: v. 面試 | n. 面試
items.colloc: job interview 面試 | conduct an interview 進行面試
items.distinct: assessment 評估 | screening 篩選
ex: The manager will interview three candidates this morning.
經理今天早上將面試三位候選人。
Be prepared for a tough interview process.
做好面對嚴格面試過程的準備。
She did very well in her final interview.
她在最後一輪面試表現得很好。

items.pos: n. 候選人 | 求職者
items.colloc: ideal candidate 理想人選 | qualified candidate 合格候選人
items.distinct: applicant 申請人 | nominee 被提名人
ex: We need to select the best candidate by Friday.
我們需要在週五前選出最佳人選。
Every candidate must answer these questions clearly.
每位候選人都必須清楚回答這些問題。
The candidate demonstrated great problem-solving skills.
該候選人展現了優秀的問題解決能力。

items.pos: n. 證書 | 資格證明
items.colloc: academic credentials 學歷證明 | verify credentials 核實資格
items.distinct: qualification 資格 | certificate 證書
ex: You must present your credentials during the interview.
面試時你必須出示你的資歷證明。
Her professional credentials are very impressive.
她的專業資歷證明令人印象深刻。
We need to verify all the candidates' credentials.
我們需要核實所有候選人的資格證明。

items.colloc: provide a reference 提供推薦 | check references 核對推薦人
items.distinct: recommendation 推薦 | contact 聯繫人
ex: Could you provide a reference from your previous employer?
你能提供前雇主的推薦信嗎？
The company will call your references tomorrow.
公司明天會打電話詢問你的證明人。
She included two professional references in her file.
她在檔案中附上了兩份專業推薦人資料。

items.pos: n. 作品集 | 投資組合
items.colloc: design portfolio 設計作品集 | show a portfolio 展示作品集
items.distinct: resume 履歷 | profile 個人簡介
ex: The applicant brought a portfolio of his best work.
該申請人帶來了他的最佳作品集。
Please email your portfolio for us to review.
請將你的作品集寄給我們審閱。
A creative portfolio is essential for this position.
這份職位必須要有創意作品集。

items.colloc: annual salary 年薪 | negotiate a salary 協商薪資
items.distinct: wage 時薪 | income 收入
ex: The company offers a competitive starting salary.
公司提供具競爭力的起薪。
We can discuss the salary after the interview.
我們面試後可以討論薪資。
Her expected salary is within our budget.
她的期望薪資在我們的預算內。

items.colloc: recruitment agency 招募顧問公司 | recruitment drive 徵才活動
items.distinct: recruiter 招募人員 | candidate 應徵者
ex: Our company launched a new recruitment drive this month.
我們公司這個月啟動了一項新的徵才活動。
The recruitment process usually takes about three weeks.
招募流程通常需要大約三個星期。
She works for a top recruitment agency in Taipei.
她任職於台北一家頂尖的招募顧問公司。

items.colloc: hire a headhunter 聘請獵頭 | executive headhunter 高階獵頭
items.distinct: recruiter 招募專員 | employer 雇主
ex: A headhunter contacted him regarding a senior executive role.
一位獵頭就高階主管職位與他聯繫。
The firm hired a headhunter to find a new CEO.
該公司聘請了獵頭公司來尋找新任執行長。
Experienced headhunters know how to source top talent effectively.
有經驗的獵頭知道如何有效地尋找頂尖人才。
